PaymentService/Authorize.threeds_manual_capture_credit_card: CONNECTOR_API_LACKS: techspec '### ThreeDS (Payer Authentication, EMV 3DS 2.2) #### 1.' — "Endpoint: None ... There is no server-to-server NMI endpoint for performing 3DS authentication" — a single-shot THREE_DS Authorize cannot be served, so G-ThreeDS-01 refuses it while the scenario asserts error.must_not_exist; the supported 3DS journey is PaymentMethodAuthenticationService/PreAuthenticate then Gateway.js then Authorize with the authentication result.
